category: Operating Systems / Linux Systems Programming / Application Security

modules.name: FastAPI Backend Service
responsibilities: HTTP API endpoints for executions, policies, experiments, system capabilities
Request validation and error sanitization
Persistence coordinator using SQLAlchemy / SQLite
Integration with sandbox execution manager

modules.name: Execution Manager & Lifecycle State Machine
responsibilities: Async job queue with bounded concurrency
Execution lifecycle state transitions
Output streaming with bounded buffers
Timeout watchdog and cancellation
Process tree supervision and resource collection

modules.name: Linux Isolation & Enforcement Engine
responsibilities: Capability detection (namespaces, cgroups v2, seccomp, bwrap)
Bubblewrap namespace and filesystem sandbox invocation
cgroups v2 hierarchy management (memory.max, cpu.max, pids.max)
Seccomp BPF policy compilation / argument synthesis
Supervision, process group reaping, signal escalation

modules.name: Security & Resource Policy Models
responsibilities: Pydantic schemas for execution policies
Default policy profiles (Standard, Strict, CPU-Restricted, Memory-Restricted)
Safe built-in experiment workloads (Normal, CPU, Memory, Timeout, NetBlock, FileEscape)
Validation against host security boundaries

modules.name: Resource Monitoring & Telemetry
responsibilities: Parsing cgroups v2 resource metrics (cpu.stat, memory.current, memory.peak)
Distinguishing requested limits vs measured consumption
Exit code interpretation (signals, OOM, timeout, syscall kill)

modules.name: React + Vite Frontend Application
responsibilities: Developer-tool dashboard with dark theme
Overview: Execution stats, queue status, capability readiness
Playground: Interactive code runner with preset workloads and live results
Executions: Searchable history, metrics inspector, exit code details
Policy Lab: Multi-policy comparative experiments with live charts
Security Policies: Policy inspector and custom configuration
System Information: Real capability probe results and Linux prerequisites
Settings: Runtime preferences and execution limits
